sources.title: Swara.AI - Advanced Audio & Singing Research
sources.snippet: Our Mission At Swara.AI, we're on a mission to revolutionize how people interact with audio and singing technologies. Founded by a team of musicians and AI researchers, we combine cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep musical knowledge to create innovative solutions for singers, musicians, and audio professionals. Our name "Swara" comes from the Sanskrit word for musical note ...

sources.title: Swara - Ashwin Madavan
sources.snippet: Swara is the South Indian word for a musical note. It's an appropriate name for a musical machine learning project that attempts to imitate the legends of South Indian music, who leverage their vast and varied musical experiences to extemporaneously produce profoundly intricate sequences of swaras.
